title: Classification Accuracy
prompt: Write a function `classification_accuracy(y_true, y_pred)` for single-label classification. `y_true` and `y_pred` are sequences of labels. If either input is empty or the lengths differ, return `-1`. Otherwise count same-position matches using Python equality (`y_true[i] == y_pred[i]`) and return `round(matches / len(y_true), 4)` as a fraction from `0.0` to `1.0`, not a percentage.

example.reasoning: Two of three same-position labels match, so accuracy is round(2 / 3, 4).
